description: Previews the printable practice sheet pages for a text or a practice preset in a chosen alphabet, style, paper size, guide and repeat count, with a PDF download from the site.

alphabet.description: Letter family: cursive or print. Default cursive.

guide.description: Guide style under the model letters. Default dotted.

paper.description: Paper size for the printable sheet. Default A4.

repeats.description: Traced repeats under each model line, 1 to 6. Default 2.

style.description: Cursive style. Default zaner-bloser. Print ignores it.

text.description: Text for the sheet, up to 500 characters.
